items.source: Invoked immediately, i.e. before this method returns.
items.translation: 立即调用，即在返回此方法之前。

items.source:
Invoked just before the mock server is built. Use this hook to inspect
and/or modify application-declared filters and exception handlers.
items.translation: 在构建模拟服务器之前立即调用。使用此钩子来检查和/或修改应用程序声明的过滤器和异常处理器。

items.source: builder - the builder for the HttpHandler that will handle requests (i.e. the mock server)
items.translation: builder - 用于处理请求（即模拟服务器）的 HttpHandler 的构建器

items.source: serverSpec - the serverSpec to which the configurer is added
items.translation: serverSpec - 配置器被添加到的 serverSpec
